name: Curacel Health Developer API
description:
Welcome to the Curacel Health API Reference! 
This API is designed to streamline and enhance your health insurance processing experience.

With these API endpoints, you would be able to create health insurance claims on our platform.

These can be used by

- EMR (electronic medical records) systems to submit claims to health insurers (HMOs)
- Health insurer ERPs to push claims to Curacel for auto adjudication
